notes: Two golden families (plan X0 3.3, decision Q12). Doctoral (D*) cases use the doctoral reference configuration (Q3): legacy storage tariff and the doctoral carbon-factor scenario; their trajectory zone is frozen. Corrected (C*) cases are snapshots that must be revised, with correction ids, in the commit that changes them.
Revision 0 of both families was captured on code equivalent to 35aadb3, so at M0 the families describe HEAD behaviour.
tier: fast = p0_gate quick, full = p0_gate full, nightly = p0_gate nightly.

Inputs are frozen: each case runs tests/golden/projects/<case>.json (the 35aadb3 value_101_study() template, network variant and overrides resolved once; verified identical when resolved with the 35aadb3 code), never the live course template. modules/parameters/runtime_options below are merged on top (no-ops for the frozen values). New cases are frozen with capture.py freeze-projects; existing snapshots are immutable.

X0 S8 (methodology profiles) added "methodology.profile": "doctoral-lineage-0.6.0a2" to the parameters of every D case in the commit that introduced the profile parameter, so the doctoral family never runs under the value-corrected default. It is the only override that is not a no-op on the frozen projects (test_golden_digest); C cases run under the default profile.

D5 (decision A12) is the GBP1 doctoral case: it runs the released GBP1 public1 research pack, which is not in the repository; run_case.py takes it from VALUE_P0_5_PACKS and accepts only the directory whose manifest.json has the pinned sha256 (research_pack); without it capture.py check lists D5 as unavailable. Its frozen project is the D-case module set (Q3 reference configuration) on value-uk-open-data-pack-v1, start_year = end_year = 2025, mode full (one model year, 17520 periods), written by hand because the course template does not describe GBP1. Revision 0 is the output of a git archive of 35aadb3 on that project (no methodology.profile parameter existed there); revision 1 re-baselines it once for the universal corrections A3 (P6-24), A5 (P6-02/03/04) and A4 (P4-01-thermal), with tests/golden/reports/D5-r1.json; docs/dev/GBP1_DOCTORAL_BEFORE_AFTER.md tabulates the differences.

C9 (FX8, decision A18) is the GBP1 corrected case: the D5 project on the local GBP1 public2 revision (value-uk-open-data-pack-public2, built by scripts/build_value_uk_pack_revision.py from GBP1 public1 and R029 public1, never published; DECISIONS A16-7) under the default corrected profile, with the D5 module set so that it equals the local acceptance run of docs/dev/GBP1_CORRECTED_LOCAL_ACCEPTANCE.md. Like D5 it is a research-pack case taken from VALUE_P0_5_PACKS by manifest sha256. Revision 0 is the output of a git archive of 39c5dd7 (before A18, station nuclear of A16-7 in force); revision 1 is A18 (fx8.nuclear-in-service-at-start). Its numeric before/after report is docs/dev/p0-reports/fx8-golden/C9-r1.json (tests/golden/reports holds doctoral trajectory reports only).
